guideline: Human annotators rate each reasoning chain on multiple criteria, including overall quality and coherence, using a Likert scale.

The dataset contains two overall scores measuring the quality (QUAL) and coherence (COH) of the reasoning chain on a Likert scale. Annotations include evaluations for factuality issues (FACT), logical deduction errors (LOGIC), hallucinations (HALL), redundant or irrelevant information (RED), unnecessary paraphrasing (REP), commonsense errors (COM), and arithmetic errors (MATH).
